20187.long_desc:
A professional 33 inch LCD Monitor designed for all arcade machines and retro game enthusiasts and a direct replacement for CRT tube monitors. The 33" arcade LCD panel offers a 4:3 viewing ratio with RGB, VGA and HDMI inputs and supports 15khz 24khz 31khz, and high definition up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution. Low response time, great colour depth the custom arcade monitor firmware. A perfect replacement for 33inch 38inch and 39inch CRT tube monitors. Get arcade ready with the 33 Inch LCD Arcade Monitor which features a premium LCD panel with 4:3 resolution, making it perfect for your old-school 15khz, 24khz and 31khz arcade games as well as offering the ability to run the latest arcade games in high definition. Highly suitable for Pedestal, split screen, showcase cabinets, as well as driving and arcade cabinets larger CRT tube monitors. The features of the new 33inch 4x3 monitor are;
  • RGB, VGA & HDMI input
  • video input support: 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution at low monitor lag
  • custom Arcooda firmware designed specifically for the arcade and amusement industries. Firmware has been designed to be plug and play for as many arcade game boards as possible, including "auto" button to quickly centre your arcade game's picture.
  • extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount inside the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine.
  • Audio output support: connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 33 inch arcade LCD monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system.
  • full viewing angle, ideal for arcade games.
  • mounting frame now supports VESA (8 x M412) or use the included mounting brackets to add into your arcade machine.
    • The Arcooda arcade monitor firmware has been refined over many years. The 33inch LCD 4x3 ratio arcade monitors come with these additional add-on parts for free; - Arcooda RGB to VGA Adapter Board with Colour Correction - Second monitor button settings board - 1.6 metre extension cable for OSD button board
